items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
items.feeQuote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Certificate of Formation (Texas LLC)
items.quote: Title 1, chapter 3, subchapter A of the BOC governs the formation of an LLC

items.name: Assumed Name Certificate
items.quote: a separate assumed name certificate must be filed for each assumed name.
items.condition: Only when trading under a name other than the legal name.

items.name: Texas sales and use tax permit
items.quote: You will need to apply using form AP-201, Texas Application (PDF) .

items.name: Certified food manager
items.agency: Texas Department of State Health Services
items.quote: The food manager certification is obtained by passing a DSHS or ANSI-CFP approved food manager certification examination.

items.name: Food handler training for staff
items.agency: Texas Department of State Health Services
items.quote: all food employees shall successfully complete an accredited food handler training course, within 30 days of employment.

items.name: Unemployment tax account
items.quote: register with the Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) within 10 days of becoming liable.

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy
items.quote: is required to obtain a Certificate of Occupancy after a new or remodeled construction

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.agency: City of Austin, with Austin Public Health
items.quote: Plan Review — required for new construction and remodels.

items.name: Pre-opening health inspection
items.quote: Pre‑Opening Inspection — required for all new establishments, remodeled facilities, and changes of ownership.

items.name: Food enterprise operating permit
items.quote: To operate a food business in Austin or Travis County, you must obtain a Food Enterprise Operating Permit.

items.name: Workers' compensation, or the yearly non-subscriber notice
items.agency: Texas Department of Insurance, Division of Workers' Compensation
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff. Texas doesn't require coverage; an employer without it files the yearly non-subscriber notice, so it is conditional.
items.quote: Annual filing, between February 1 and April 30 each year.

notes: Not included (no official page found that states it): the Austin building permit for the finish-out. The plan lists it as an abstention naming the City of Austin.
